profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
Results-driven Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in mission-critical C++ development, embedded systems, and real-time software development using RTOS for defense/aerospace applications. Proven expertise in designing and implementing high-performance, real-time applications for mission-critical systems, including radar, camera, and weapon systems. Experienced Product Owner skilled in cross-platform development in Linux and Windows environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance across diverse systems. Passionate about mentoring junior engineers, driving innovation, and delivering high-quality
software solutions ahead of schedule.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as both Product Owner and one of the lead programmers, prioritizing feature delivery while actively contributing to
development. Played a key role in driving the project to completion ahead of schedule by effectively balancing business
requirements with technical constraints.
• Leveraged advanced C++ programming skills to develop high-performance, reliable, and secure software solutions, directly
contributing to the enhanced weapon capabilities of the F-35 program.
• Performed static code analysis using Parasoft to identify defects, enforce coding standards, and enhance software quality
and maintainability.
• Facilitated SCRUM ceremonies, including sprint planning and retrospectives, while managing the product backlog to align
business requirements with technical execution.
• Coordinated project timelines, tracked progress, and implemented risk mitigation strategies, ensuring the on-time delivery
of software components despite evolving requirements.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues in requirements, ensuring smoother workflows and
faster delivery cycles.
• Supported lab integration efforts, streamlining processes that accelerated product deployment and helped meet critical
milestones.
• Mentored and coached junior engineers, promoting best practices in software development
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Debugging Code · Bitbucket · Gitlab · Software Testing · Jira · C++ · Embedded Software

positions.title: Software Airworthiness Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for establishing and managing software airworthiness evidence in support of a military qualification and successful completion of airworthiness contract deliverables and flight releases throughout the lifecycle of the product.
Prepare and maintain compliance matrix to track the level of compliance to the certification requirements
Participate in SOI (1-4) audits of supplier’s adherence to software lifecycle documents
Primary interface with certification authorities for certifying supplier software
Review and approve supplier software deliverables as defined in Statement of Work
Experience certifying manned/unmanned air vehicles and air systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for porting an existing Radar Toolkit Simulation from Windows to Linux.
Modified existing C/C++ code to build cross-platform by leveraging system APIs.
Analyzing, designing, and implementing change requests for the code and UI.
Created training documentation for both Linux and Windows workstations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the software design, testing, and integration of code for embedded systems for multiple types of camera and radar sensors.
As a software engineer, my primary tasks consist of writing code and developing test software for these sensors. This role provides a variety of challenges to overcome such as system integration while working remotely.
- Hands on experience developing real-time software applications for advanced multifunctioning radar using various coding languages including but not limited to C, C++, Java, Perl, Python, and MATLAB. 
- Designed and developed GUI for camera hardware to interface with Level 2 commands, which demonstrated hands-on experience analyzing system requirements and implementing new features to match.
- Responsible for testing, data collection, and debugging with physical radar hardware and simulators. 
Collaborated with senior engineers to execute Final Qualification Testing under client observation. 
- Developed, modified, and integrated SCPI drivers for new hardware to integrate on existing test systems.
- Effectively communicated project requirements, ideas, and strategies with both the software team and quality assurance group to ensure that everyone involved had a solid grasp of the task at hand.
- Continuously improved internal processes and code libraries.
- Coded and peer-reviewed in accordance with a strict adherence to MISRA and DO-178B standards and practices.
- Thrive in team environments and possess a talent for leading others in high-demand situations when appropriate.
- Display teamwork and collaboration skills by effectively communicating with the team and cross-discipline in a concise and timely manner. 
- Outstanding ability to multitask in stressful environments through time management and effective communication.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging Code · Software Testing · Embedded Software · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · C++

positions.title: Bail Bond Agent
positions.description:
I work directly with clients making bond arrangements by facilitating communication between customers and their family. I strive to create long lasting business relationships with every patron I encounter by being personable, treating them with respect, a being understanding no matter their current situation.
I am responsible for training new employees to provide excellent customer service to our clients, as well as instructing the employee how to make risk assessments to mitigate lost revenue. I meticulously create or update biographical documentation with every client during every bail bond transaction.
During my time at Liberty Bail Bonds I have improved and streamlined multiple documents, as well as the company business card. These improvements have resulted in higher customer satisfaction, increased company-wide productivity, and reduced the financial risk bail bond companies are plagued with.

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description: Specialized in repairing and maintaining the Ultra High Frequency Sat-com on the USS Tortuga LSD 46. I was awarded the Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal, Humanitarian Service Medal, National Defense Service Medal, and Global War on Terrorism Service Medal. Two of these medals were because of exemplary performance during a time of crisis. My time spent in the military gave me hands-on experience working with a team in a fast paced, mission critical, environment.
